Package edu.cnu.mdi.splot.fit

Class FitResult

java.lang.Object
edu.cnu.mdi.splot.fit.FitResult
public final class FitResult extends Object
Generic result for a (weighted) least-squares fit.

This class is intentionally model-agnostic: it stores parameter values and common diagnostics that apply across nonlinear and linear least-squares fits (Gaussian, erf/erfc, exponential, polynomial, etc.).
